pass_rule.part_A: MM1-v3.2 on the PRIMARY footing by E215's rule form on each card over its NO-TWIN cases (every class): a case passes T1, T2, T3, E3, E4 when |error| is within the band, E1, E2 when |error| is within the band or, at a watts case, |watts difference| within the watts band; a rule PASSES when at least 90% of its cases pass, FAILS otherwise, TOO FEW under 10 cases, NO DATA with none. PART A PASSES when no rule FAILS on any card and at least one rule PASSES; FAILS when any rule fails (named); else NOT DECIDED

pass_rule.verdict: PASS when part A passes; FAIL when it fails (named); NOT DECIDED otherwise.
